title: cfs cookie notice
description: A small deep-navy notice card pinned to the bottom-right corner (full width on phones) with a soft drop shadow: an orange spaced-capitals eyebrow trailing a hairline, a short light title, a line of small text with an orange policy link, and two square buttons (outlined decline, orange accept that turns white on hover). It slides up and fades in on load while an orange bar grows across its top edge.
notes: fixed to the window by default (fixed={false} keeps it in the flow); either button hides it for this visit
a `dark` subtree on the theme's background colour (the deep navy in cfs-theme)
